If prohibited conduct is confirmed, or if necessary to protect security and other users, the Company may restrict use after prior notice. Urgent security measures may be taken before notice is given. Users may provide an explanation through customer support.

Article 9. Changes and Interruptions

TT Softs Personal Information Consent and Privacy Policy

Effective date: September 20, 2026

TT Softs (the “Company”) values the personal information of In My Pocket Slots users and processes it as described below under applicable law. Consent to the collection and use of the required information below is necessary for sign-in, cloud saves and game services. You may refuse consent; however, without it, account identification and game data storage are unavailable and the Service cannot be used.

1. Information processed
The Company may process the following when providing the Service.
• Account information: Firebase user ID (UID), sign-in provider and the minimum account information supplied by social sign-in providers.
• Profile information: Your chosen nickname and character settings.
• Game information: Coin and ticket balances, owned items, slot unlocks, reward status, spin counts and ranking submissions.
• Technical information: App version, operating system, access times, error and security logs, IP addresses and other information automatically generated during operation.
Choices concerning advertising identifiers and personalized ads are not included in this required consent. A separate consent interface will be provided when mobile advertising is enabled.
The Company does not intentionally collect sensitive information unnecessary for the Service, such as resident registration numbers or actual financial information.

2. Purposes
• Sign-in, account identification and data recovery across devices.
• Game progress, balances, rewards, outfits and ranking features.
• Preventing duplicate rewards and improper use; maintaining security.
• Error analysis, customer support and service quality improvements.
• Providing rewarded ads chosen by users and verifying completion.
• Compliance with law and handling disputes.

3. Collection methods
Information may be entered directly by users, generated during gameplay or collected through SDKs and server communications of integrated services such as Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore and Google Mobile Ads.

4. Retention and use
In principle, the Company deletes personal information without delay upon account closure, a deletion request or completion of its processing purpose. Where required by law or necessary to address misuse or disputes, the minimum information may be retained separately for that purpose and the statutory period. Guest users without account identification information may have difficulty verifying ownership when requesting recovery or deletion.

5. Disclosure to third parties
The Company does not sell users' personal information beyond the scope stated in this policy. Personal information is not disclosed to third parties except where authorized by law or separately consented to by the user.

6. Outsourced and overseas processing
The Company may use these external services:
• Google LLC / Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Functions: Authentication, game data storage, server processing and security.
• Google LLC / Google Mobile Ads (AdMob), User Messaging Platform: Mobile ads, consent management, advertising performance and abuse prevention.
Information may be transferred over encrypted networks during service use and processed at domestic or overseas data centers operated by Google. Data categories, countries and storage locations may vary with usage conditions and Google's infrastructure. Outsourced information is processed for service provision and legally required retention periods. Before official release, detailed processors, destination countries, transfer timing and methods, and retention periods will be disclosed again based on the services and contracts actually used.

7. Advertising choices
Mobile apps with advertising enabled may display Google User Messaging Platform or an equivalent consent interface as required by regional law. Users may change personalized advertising preferences. Without consent, limited ads may still be shown or some ad features may be restricted. Initial acceptance of this app's terms does not replace consent to personalized advertising.

8. Your rights
You may request access, correction, deletion, suspension of processing or withdrawal of consent for your personal information. Requests may be sent to the contact below. The Company will verify identity and process requests according to applicable law. Information editable within the app may be changed using those features.

9. Deletion methods
Electronic information is deleted to make recovery difficult when its retention period ends or its purpose is fulfilled. Information that must be retained separately by law is separated from other information with restricted access.

10. Security measures
The Company applies technical and administrative safeguards including authentication, access management, encryption in transit, database security rules, change histories and conflict checks.

11. Children's information
The Service is not intended for children under 14. If the Company learns that information of a user under 14 has been processed without lawful consent, it will investigate and take necessary action, including deletion.

12. Policy changes
Changes to this policy, their effective date and key details will be announced in the Service. Changes materially affecting users' rights will be notified using the methods and periods required by law.

13. Privacy contact
Operator and privacy contact: TT Softs
Email: admin.ttsoft@gmail.com

This policy is a draft reflecting the Service currently in development. Before official release, business information, actual processors and overseas transfers, account deletion procedures and statutory retention periods will be reviewed and finalized for the actual operation.
